error[ZBX-E0564]: the subject token for workload identity cannot be read
  cause  the subject token from the credential_source file can't be read, or is
         empty, or is larger than 16384 bytes
  source file
  fix    check that the token is there and current: an OIDC token lasts minutes
         in GitHub Actions the job needs 'permissions: id-token: write'
  more   zbx explain E0564
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0564.html
